entries.title: Product Design Intern (f/m/d) M A R C H 2 0 2 6 – A U G U S T 2 0 2 6 Are you passionate about creating design that inspires? At Noto, we focus on bringing product experiences to life. Based in a beautiful old factory near Cologne, we’re a team of 15 creatives who love to challenge conventions and push design boundaries. Why intern with us? 🌟Inspire & be inspired: From ideation to prototyping, explore trends and tools that drive product excellence. 🚀Hands-on experience: With 20+ years of expertise, you’ll contribute to real projects alongside experienced designers. 🤝Collaborative environment: Work in an open, diverse environment where your ideas truly matter. 💡Creative impact: Design products that improve how people live, work and interact. 🏓Community & fun: Enjoy team lunches from our in-house chef, table tennis matches and fun after-work activities. Be part of a team that balances excellence with passion, creating designs that are not only visually intriguing but also aim to make a positive impact in the world!
